method: Source inspection of the installed pinned host package (npm ci from integrations/openclaw/package-lock.json) plus the CI and VPS captures listed in the record. File digests were computed on the linux_host VPS and matched a second npm ci on the owner's MacBook byte for byte. Hook and middleware behaviour below is read from the shipped code and documentation; none of the candidate gates was exercised on a running host by this search.

machine_runs.person_trial: setup_unavailable: private_network_unavailable (only a public IPv4 on eth0; no sudo; unprivileged user namespaces are restricted by AppArmor)
machine_runs.browser: Playwright 1.64.1 chromium-1248 and chromium_headless_shell-1248 lack libgbm.so.1 and libasound.so.2 (ldd: not found); no system packages installed

skill_loaded_use.question: A supported point that can stop or fence the next model request after skills_read, with fresh genuine host authority for that turn (spec 7.6.1 use-time fence).

surfaces.name: before_tool_call
surfaces.kind: gate (terminal block, fail closed on error/timeout)
surfaces.can_stop: the managed read (skills_read) before it runs
surfaces.context: agentId, sessionKey, sessionId, runId, toolCallId, abortSignal, requester{channel,accountId,senderId,senderIsOwner,roleIds}; the host keeps its executionIdentityToken/receiptAuthority receipt internal
surfaces.authority: none: no session access authority, no assertCurrent, no lifecycleRevision; hook contexts are excluded as authority by 7.6.2(2)

surfaces.name: api.registerAgentToolResultMiddleware
surfaces.kind: async tool-result transform before the harness feeds output back to the model; a throw replaces the result with a failure result
surfaces.can_stop: instruction bytes reaching the model (replaces the tool result); does not stop the model request itself
surfaces.authority: none (same as above); needs manifest contracts.agentToolResultMiddleware and explicit enablement

surfaces.name: provider wrapStreamFn / options.onPayload (RelayMind's own provider)
surfaces.kind: the provider transport for every model request of the composition; a throw in onPayload fails the request before it is sent
surfaces.can_stop: the next model request before HTTP dispatch
surfaces.context: ProviderWrapStreamFnContext: agentId, auth facts, model, extraParams, thinkingLevel, streamFn; per call: context.messages, options.sessionId
surfaces.authority: none: no sessionKey, lifecycleRevision or person authority

surfaces.name: before_agent_run
surfaces.can_stop: the run once, before its first model submission
surfaces.verdict: does not reach the post-read model request of the same run

surfaces.name: tool_result_persist, before_message_write
surfaces.can_stop: transcript persistence only; promises ignored, errors logged

surfaces.name: GatewaySessionAccessAuthority.retain()
surfaces.kind: original-person access borrow {signal, assertCurrent, release} obtainable inside a sessionAccess gateway method handler
surfaces.can_stop: nothing by itself; the only host object found that could carry person currentness past the RPC into a later turn
surfaces.authority: a native delegation candidate whose acquisition, scope, lifetime and revocation 7.6.1/7.6.2(2) require to be qualified separately; spec 0.66 defines no such qualification

surfaces.name: dispatchGatewayMethod (openclaw/plugin-sdk/gateway-method-runtime)
surfaces.kind: in-process dispatch inside an original authenticated plugin request
surfaces.authority: only within the original request scope; unavailable to hooks and the provider during a later agent run
surfaces.verdict: cannot re-run the fence's skills.library.read at use time

host_observations: CI run 41286397320: stale and deleted controls still delivered the pinned revision's bytes on the next turn (observed loaded_pinned_revision); the host keeps the session pin after a library head update or removal.

sessions.reset requires operator.admin (core-method-policy); the configured person policy lacks it. The native Control UI new-session control calls sessions.reset (declaring requiredScope operator.admin) only for a board session and otherwise sessions.create (control-ui-boot-chat).
skills_read takes only {name} (docs/tools/skills.md); the name resolves to the session pin on this host.
skill_loaded_use.conclusion: Points that can stop the read or the next request exist, but none carries the fresh host person authority (or a qualified native delegation) that the 7.6.1 use-time fence must check at the final boundary. No point can fence the next model request: finding stop_point_absent; skill_loaded_use stays disabled.

mcp_use.question: A public route a plugin may use to invoke an exact MCP identity (server/original/exposed name/schema/currentness tuple) for an independent tool.

routes.name: tools.invoke
routes.params: closed {name, args?, sessionKey?, agentId?, confirm?, idempotencyKey?, conversationReadOrigin?}

routes.name: mcp.app.callTool (and mcp.app.listTools)
routes.verdict: requires an active MCP App view bound to requester/session; independent tools have none; CI capture: mcp.app.listTools refused without a viewId; no legitimate selected-asset-to-view binding exists

routes.name: openclaw/plugin-sdk/agent-harness-tool-runtime (runAgentHarnessToolInvocation) and openclaw/plugin-sdk/codex-mcp-projection (materializeStaticMcpToolsForHarnessRun)
routes.verdict: documented private (harness-only, not for third-party plugins); calling a materialized tool's execute is excluded by 7.6.2(3)

routes.name: dispatchGatewayMethod -> tools.effective
routes.verdict: read-only discovery; CI capture: ok with an empty tool list for the person session while both disposable stdio servers listed append

mcp_use.conclusion: No public route reaches an exact MCP identity on 2026.10.7: finding exact_route_absent; mcp_use stays disabled and relaymind.mcp is not registered.
